addonFailureNormalization.browserCase: settings visibly rejects CORS, malformed, invalid-shape and unsafe-looking provider errors
addonFailureNormalization.behavior: Network/CORS, invalid JSON and manifest-shape failures now present fixed, actionable messages; provider HTTP status text is preserved. Raw engine text is asserted absent from the alert.

firefoxDifferences.detail: This Playwright Firefox build reports no H.264 support: video.canPlayType('video/mp4; codecs="avc1.42c02a"') is empty and MediaCapabilities decodingInfo reports supported=false. The bundled quality fixtures are H.264 MP4/HLS/DASH, so decoding cannot occur. The app does surface the startup playback error overlay with a nonempty reason instead of hanging.

All overlay/title/message/engine-switch assertions passed. The failing assertion is the Chromium-specific expectation that the manifest URL appears in requestfailed; Firefox reports the blocked request differently.

firefoxDifferences.test: bundled native preference ordering and provider-order autoplay
firefoxDifferences.detail: Because H.264 is unsupported here, the declared 4K H.264 source moves to the last prediction bucket while the VP8/Opus source is ranked first. The tests hardcode Chromium's prediction order instead of deriving it from the engine's own canPlayType results.

codecProbe.note: Chromium/Chrome predict H.264 support and decode the same fixtures, which is why the existing journey remains a Chromium-family result.

passedInFirefox: The complete guest journey (install legal add-on -> catalog -> save -> VP8/Opus playback -> pause/seek/resume -> subtitle -> Back -> browse -> reload), add-on install/toggle, synthetic identity/Library, source capabilities, sidecars, smoke and PWA-independent shell cases.
